title: REQ · Zero remaining quota shows an inline 'used all your suggestions' message
summary: Inline message appears when remaining quota is 0
description: Context: remaining is computed at ContributionSheet.tsx L67 from sent entries. Desired behavior: when remaining is 0 the sheet renders 'You have used all your suggestions this round' inline. Expected result: the player sees why sending is unavailable. Why: clear feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Given 5 sent contributions loaded from history When the sheet opens Then 'You have used all your suggestions this round' is visible with role alert
Given fewer than 5 sent contributions When the sheet opens Then the message is absent

preserve: Existing counter text and validation messages

definition_of_done: Message renders only at zero quota
